More info

Weekend Non-Camping

1st Release
More info
  • Secure your ticket with a £20 deposit, followed by monthly instalments - choose 'Ticketmaster Instalments' at checkout.
  • Weekend Non-Camping tickets allow daily access to the arena from 11am on Friday 27th, Saturday 28th and Sunday 29th August 2027
  • There is no readmission with a Weekend Non-Camping ticket so you cannot leave the site and re-enter the same day and will not be able to leave temporarily to access cars, or nearby shops etc. Make sure you bring everything you need with you for the whole day but please remember that bags need to be smaller than A4 size. Don’t worry, your ticket will still be valid the following day when you return.
  • There is no access to campsites for Weekend Non-Camping Tickets and they cannot be used in conjunction with Campervan Passes, Campsite Tickets or VIP Camping Upgrades.

Access to Piccadilly Party and LS23 is for camping ticketholders only. Weekend non-camping tickets do not have access to the PiccadillyParty and LS23 stages. No camping or access to campsites is permitted with anon-camping ticket.
